name: Skill Check & Token Dashboard

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["evaluation.yml"]
    types:
      - completed
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC to aggregate data
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_update:
        description: 'Force dashboard update'
        required: false
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  collect-and-render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Download Token Metrics Artifacts
        id: download-artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          pattern: token-metrics-*
          path: ./artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Aggregate Token Data
        run: |
          # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p ./dashboard-data
          
          # Run the PowerShell script to pull and aggregate data
          # This script handles pulling workflow run artifacts and aggregating into dashboard format
          pwsh -File ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1 -InputPath ./artifacts -OutputPath ./dashboard-data/token-usage.json

      - name: Generate Dashboard
        run: |
          # Install dependencies for dashboard generation if needed
          npm install --no-save jsdom canvas
          
          # Render the dashboard using the token-usage.js script
          # This generates the HTML dashboard with KPIs, charts, and drill-downs
          node ./scripts/token-usage.js --input ./dashboard-data/token-usage.json --output ./docs/dashboard/index.html

      - name: Upload Dashboard Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-dashboard
          path: ./docs/dashboard/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./docs/dashboard
          force_orphan: true
